analyzed_vuln.description: aax_filter unconditionally calls av_aes_init(c->aes_decrypt, c->file_key, 128, 1) even when AES context/key material were never initialized for non-AAX inputs. In this PoV, MOV parsing reaches the AAX decryption path with invalid/uninitialized c->file_key data, so av_aes_init reads past the 16-byte key buffer during key schedule setup (UBSan: index 32 out of bounds in libavutil/aes.c:256). The crash manifests in av_aes_init, but the root cause is unsafe invocation from aax_filter without validating AAX mode/state.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Demuxing a crafted MOV/ISOBMFF file (here avif-branded fuzz input) that drives mov_read_packet into the aax_filter path while AAX crypto state is not properly established (no valid AAX/AAXC key setup). aax_filter then uses c->aes_decrypt/c->file_key regardless of mode and calls av_aes_init, triggering out-of-bounds key-schedule access in aes.c. Data flow: target_dem_fuzzer -> avformat_find_stream_info -> mov_read_packet -> aax_filter -> av_aes_init.
